name: siakamtrade
caption:
TRADE COURT, CASE #1: WHO WON THE PASCAL TRADE? 🎮🏀 We sent Pascal Siakam to Indiana for three first-round picks. Who won?

• Jan 17, 2024: Pascal to the Pacers for Bruce Brown, Jordan Nwora, Kira Lewis Jr. and 3 firsts
• Last full season with us (2022-23): 24.2 PPG
• 2025: East Finals MVP and a trip to the NBA Finals
• Pascal, first 13 games this season: 23.1 PPG
• Indiana's pick became Ja'Kobe Walter (#19): 10.8 PPG through 13 games

Who won the trade?

Your verdict: comment W or L 👇
Case #2 drops tomorrow night. Follow so you don't miss it.

facts.claim: On 17 January 2024 (Jan 17) Siakam was traded to the Indiana Pacers for Bruce Brown, Jordan Nwora, Kira Lewis Jr. and three (3) first-round picks; NBA champion 2019; All-NBA Second Team 2020 and Third Team 2022 (2x All-NBA); final season with Toronto 2023-24, so 2022-23 was his last full season with us; 2025 Eastern Conference Finals MVP (ECF MVP) and second finals appearance
2024 draft pick 19 (#19): Ja'Kobe Walter to the Toronto Raptors (from Indiana), via the Siakam trade
